elements.requirement: A person has a disability if that person has a physical or mental impairment that has a substantial and long-term adverse effect on their ability to carry out normal day-to-day activities.
elements.quote: P has a physical or mental impairment, and (b) the impairment has a substantial and long-term adverse effect on P's ability to carry out normal day-to-day activities.

elements.requirement: A statutory reference to a disabled person is defined as a reference to a person who has a disability.
elements.quote: A reference to a disabled person is a reference to a person who has a disability.

elements.requirement: In relation to the protected characteristic of disability, a reference to a person who has a particular protected characteristic is defined as a reference to a person who has a particular disability.
elements.quote: a reference to a person who has a particular protected characteristic is a reference to a person who has a particular disability

elements.requirement: In relation to the protected characteristic of disability, a reference to persons who share a protected characteristic is defined as a reference to persons who have the same disability.
elements.quote: a reference to persons who share a protected characteristic is a reference to persons who have the same disability.

elements.requirement: The Equality Act 2010 applies in relation to a person who has had a disability in the same way as it applies to a person who currently has the disability, subject to the exclusion of Part 12 and section 190.
elements.quote: This Act (except Part 12 and section 190) applies in relation to a person who has had a disability as it applies in relation to a person who has the disability

elements.requirement: Except in Part 12 and section 190, any reference (however expressed) to a person who has a disability includes a reference to a person who has had the disability.
elements.quote: a reference (however expressed) to a person who has a disability includes a reference to a person who has had the disability

elements.requirement: Except in Part 12 and section 190, any reference (however expressed) to a person who does not have a disability includes a reference to a person who has not had the disability.
elements.quote: a reference (however expressed) to a person who does not have a disability includes a reference to a person who has not had the disability.

elements.requirement: A Minister of the Crown is permitted to issue guidance regarding matters to be taken into account when determining any question for the purposes of subsection (1).
elements.quote: A Minister of the Crown may issue guidance about matters to be taken into account in deciding any question for the purposes of subsection (1).

elements.requirement: Schedule 1 (disability: supplementary provision) has legal effect.
